Entity name The e-kagaku Association of Global Science and Education

Entity Academic / Education
Nation Japan
Oneliner

Educational and amateur radio mission.
Description
  1. TNC Development Develop original TNC for ground station and share the know-how to other amateur radio operators. TNC materials that have been developed are listed below. TNC system design overview.
  2. Analogue FM Audio Transmission Conduct a digi-talker. Amateur radio operators can receive our voice data. The voice data includes a greeting from the developer.
  3. Youth Education Provide education opportunities to junior high and high school students. Students design the systems and participate in operations.
  4. SLR (Satellite Laser Ranging) / Non-amateur Mission Measure the round-trip flight time of ultrashort pulses of light to the satellite. Laser irradiation and ranging are performed periodically with the cooperation of JAXA and laser sites in other countries.
  • On-orbit demonstration of satellite laser ranging technology using a miniature laser reflector (mini Mt. FUJI).
  • Building project-based learning programmes through satellite development. Middle and high school students have been working on this project.
  • On-orbit demonstration of integrally moulded frames (Mono Base Frame).
  • The operation of the Digitalker function, which can be used by amateur radio operators.
  • Original development and technology dissemination of TNC (Terminal Node Controller).
